HOW TO PLAY

  1. Set your bet and difficulty.
  2. Start the round, then pick a zone.
  3. Hits boost your multiplier. Keep going or cash out.
  4. You start with two strikes. One miss ends the round and loses your bet.
FULL RULES & ODDS

Results are drawn when you select a zone. Difficulty stays locked during the round. Position and swing timing do not change the odds.

EASY · RTP 98%
RESULTBONUSFIRSTLATER

Bonuses multiply together without rounding. Payout includes your bet and is rounded down to 0.01 CR only at settlement. Displayed multipliers are rounded down to two decimals.

All 25 successful selections, or a multiplier above 10,000×, trigger automatic cash out at the full accumulated multiplier. Unplayed zones are revealed when the round ends; their symbols do not affect your payout.

GAME SETTINGS

This demo uses virtual credits only. Refreshing resets your balance and progress. RTP Ver 1 uses the supplied 98% probability tables. Currency rounding can reduce the actual return.
